title: dont-bleed-empty-after-extract (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: extract creates the named locals. Negation of the conjunction of empty checks does not imply that arr is empty; nonempty string elements can reach the loop.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago false_positive: unexpected diagnostic(s): invalid-iterator@10, mixed-argument@10, mixed-assignment@10, undefined-variable@10, undefined-variable@7.
